findings.issue: D06 create/start/cancel/take/retire status functions are not distinguished from nonfallible void cleanup. A void start cannot establish accepted-versus-rejected responsibility as required by the explicit profile.
findings.required: The known D06 profile requires u32 status on nonrelease steps; release remains the exact no-fail owner cleanup.
findings.resolution: Resolved and independently rechecked on b459fdedb0a71be564a0dbb16355d0baa429d80c.

findings.issue: Notification profile permits owned outputs and payload lifetime beyond the callback despite the pinned borrowed-notification/typed-take rule.
findings.required: D05 notification payloads stay within callback lifetime; owned result transfer occurs through the declared later typed-take path.
